title: Sebastian and the Visitor
author: Mara Amberdale
blurb: Orsen Kavanagh, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
